items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I subbed for Frank Perkins a few times while he was ill

ctx.x: Yeah, I did that. I didn't do much, I think I subbed for Frank Perkins a few times while he was ill, he was having an operation of some kind, but that was his show. He's the guy who wrote, “Stars Fell on Alabama.”
